segments.sn36.15:1.1: Atha kho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi, ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn36.15:1.2: “katamā nu kho, bhante, vedanā, katamo vedanāsamudayo, katamo vedanānirodho, katamā vedanānirodhagāminī paṭipadā?
segments.sn36.15:1.3: Ko vedanāya assādo, ko ādīnavo, kiṃ nissaraṇanti?
segments.sn36.15:1.5: sukhā vedanā, dukkhā vedanā, adukkhamasukhā vedanā –
segments.sn36.15:1.9: Ayameva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo vedanānirodhagāminī paṭipadā, seyyathidaṃ –
segments.sn36.15:1.11: Yaṃ vedanaṃ paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ, ayaṃ vedanāya assādo.
segments.sn36.15:1.12: Yā vedanā aniccā dukkhā vipariṇāmadhammā, ayaṃ vedanāya ādīnavo.
segments.sn36.15:1.13: Yo vedanāya chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānaṃ, idaṃ vedanāya nissaraṇaṃ.
segments.sn36.15:1.14: Atha kho panānanda, mayā anupubbasaṅkhārānaṃ nirodho akkhāto.
segments.sn36.15:1.15: Paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa vācā niruddhā hoti…pe…
segments.sn36.15:1.16: saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpannassa saññā ca vedanā ca niruddhā honti.
segments.sn36.15:1.17: Khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno rāgo niruddho hoti, doso niruddho hoti, moho niruddho hoti.
segments.sn36.15:1.18: Atha kho panānanda, mayā anupubbasaṅkhārānaṃ vūpasamo akkhāto.
segments.sn36.15:1.19: Paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa vācā vūpasantā hoti…pe…
segments.sn36.15:1.20: saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpannassa saññā ca vedanā ca vūpasantā honti.
segments.sn36.15:1.21: Khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno rāgo vūpasanto hoti, doso vūpasanto hoti, moho vūpasanto hoti.
segments.sn36.15:1.22: Atha kho panānanda, mayā anupubbasaṅkhārānaṃ paṭippassaddhi akkhātā.
segments.sn36.15:1.23: Paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa vācā paṭippassaddhā hoti…pe…
segments.sn36.15:1.28: Saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpannassa saññā ca vedanā ca paṭippassaddhā honti.
segments.sn36.15:1.29: Khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno rāgo paṭippassaddho hoti, doso paṭippassaddho hoti, moho paṭippassaddho hotī”ti.

lines: Purimāni panettha dve paripuṇṇapassaddhikāni, pacchimāni upaḍḍhapassaddhikāni.
Heṭṭhā kathitanayāneva, veneyyajjhāsayato pana tesaṃ desanāti daṭṭhabbaṃ.
Purimāni dve “paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa vācā paṭippassaddhā hotī”tiādinā nayena yāva khīṇāsavassa kilesapaṭippassaddhi, tāva desanāya pavattattā “paripuṇṇapassaddhikānī”ti vuttāni.
Tāva paripūraṃ katvā adesitattā “pacchimāni upaḍḍhapassaddhikāni, desanāyā”tiādi vuttaṃ.
